{{Short description|Mathematics award}}
The '''Sophie Germain Prize''' (in [[French language|French]]: ''Prix Sophie Germain'') is an annual mathematics prize awarded by the [[French Academy of Sciences]] to researchers who have carried out fundamental research in mathematics. The award has been conferred every year since 2003 and comes with a €8000 cash prize. It is named after the French mathematician [[Sophie Germain]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/prix/laureats_2015.pdf|year=2015|publisher=French Academy of Sciences|title=Grand prix attribués en 2015|language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.academie-sciences.fr/pdf/prix/laureats_2017.pdf|year=2017|publisher=French Academy of Sciences|title=Grand prix attribués en 2017|language=fr}}</ref><ref>[https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Prix-en-mathematiques-physique-mecanique-informatique-et-sciences-de-la-Terre-et-de-l-univers/prix-sophie-germain-fondation-de-l-nstitut-de-france.html Prix Sophie Germain page officielle]</ref>
